# Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health

> Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health is a leading institution for public health education, research, and training across nine academic departments and numerous research centers.

The school offers Master's and doctoral degrees, executive education, and fellowships in public health specializations including biostatistics, epidemiology, environmental health, global health, and health policy. With 500+ faculty members and strong alumni networks, Harvard Chan School advances global health through research, education, and collaborative partnerships.

## Admissions & Applications

- [Admissions](https://hsph.harvard.edu/admissions): Admissions hub with application process, requirements, and financial aid information
- [Applying to a Degree Program](https://hsph.harvard.edu/admissions/applying-to-a-degree-program): Step-by-step guide to applying for Master's and doctoral programs via SOPHAS
- [Why Harvard Chan?](https://hsph.harvard.edu/admissions/why-harvard-chan): Information on Harvard Chan's faculty excellence, diversity, and student community benefits
- [Admissions Events and Webinars](https://hsph.harvard.edu/admissions/admissions-events-and-webinars): Virtual and in-person admissions events, office hours, and webinars for prospective students

## Degrees & Programs

- [Degrees & Programs](https://hsph.harvard.edu/degrees-and-programs): Overview of Master's, doctoral, and non-degree public health programs and concentrations
- [Program Finder](https://hsph.harvard.edu/program-finder): Interactive tool to discover public health degree programs by department and interest
- [Interdisciplinary Concentrations](https://hsph.harvard.edu/degrees-and-programs/concentrations): Interdisciplinary concentrations including climate health, epidemiology, and humanitarian studies
- [Fellowships and Special Programs](https://hsph.harvard.edu/degrees-and-programs/fellowships-special-programs): Training grants and fellowships in cancer prevention, AIDS research, and global health
- [Undergraduate and High School Programs](https://hsph.harvard.edu/degrees-and-programs/undergraduate-and-high-school-programs): Summer programs and youth education in biostatistics, data science, and public health

## Financial Aid

- [Tuition and Financial Aid](https://hsph.harvard.edu/tuition-and-financial-aid): Comprehensive financial aid information including tuition, scholarships, and student loans
- [Policies and Disclosures](https://hsph.harvard.edu/tuition-and-financial-aid/policies-and-disclosures): Federal financial aid policies, loan information, and academic progress standards

## Faculty & Research

- [Faculty & Research](https://hsph.harvard.edu/faculty-and-research): Overview of 500+ faculty members and research centers across public health disciplines
- [Academic Departments](https://hsph.harvard.edu/departments): Overview of nine academic departments including biostatistics, epidemiology, environmental health
- [Research Centers, Institutes, and Labs](https://hsph.harvard.edu/research-centers-institutes-and-labs): Directory of research centers and institutes conducting public health research initiatives
- [Faculty and Researcher Profiles](https://hsph.harvard.edu/profiles): Searchable directory of faculty and researcher profiles across Harvard Chan School
- [Resources for Researchers](https://hsph.harvard.edu/resources-for-researchers): Support resources for researchers including programs, education, and admissions information

## Professional Development

- [Executive and Continuing Education](https://hsph.harvard.edu/exec-ed): Professional development programs in healthcare leadership and public health specializations

## Community & News

- [Home](https://hsph.harvard.edu): Harvard Chan School homepage showcasing research, education, and collaboration for global health improvement
- [News](https://hsph.harvard.edu/news): News hub featuring public health stories, research updates, and student achievements
- [Support Harvard Chan School](https://hsph.harvard.edu/alumni-friends/support-harvard-chan-school): Alumni fundraising and philanthropic giving opportunities to support Harvard Chan School missions
